Vendored third-party code used by the free tool pages (`public/tools/`), both MIT-licensed:

- `astronomy.min.js` — [astronomy-engine](https://github.com/cosinekitty/astronomy) by Don Cross. Provides real planetary/Sun/Moon ephemeris calculations (sunrise/sunset, ecliptic longitudes) used by the Vedic astrology tools. License header preserved at the top of the file.
- `cities.js` — city → coordinates/timezone lookup, trimmed from the [`city-timezones`](https://github.com/kevinroberts/city-timezones) npm package (world cities with population > 20,000, plus all Indian cities).
